content: Angular NG0200 guidance: forwardRef() is NOT the recommended fix for service-to-service circular dependencies (it only helps standalone-component circular imports). Recommended fixes are refactoring the dependency graph directly, using Observables/Subjects for decoupled async communication, or extracting a facade/shared lower-level service both depend on. Confirms that if no true cycle exists, plain constructor injection is correct; if one did, restructuring (not forwardRef/Injector) is the idiomatic fix.
